title: Interactive Protocols & Logic Gates
description: Agent, it's time to make Chronos interactive. Learn to accept user commands, process real-time data, and make logical decisions based on input. Your programs will come alive.

exercises.title: Clearance Check: Input Data Type
exercises.description: CHRONOS SECURITY: What data type does the input() function ALWAYS return by default?

exercises.title: Clearance Check: Boolean Evaluation
exercises.description: CHRONOS LOGIC GATE: Evaluate the expression: 10 > 5

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Field Status Transmission
exercises.description: CHRONOS COMMAND CENTER: Field operative reporting from active mission zone. Establish secure communication channel to receive mission status update. Use input() function to prompt the agent for their current operational status report. Store the transmission for command review.
exercises.targetCode: mission_status = input("Please enter your current mission status report: ")

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Reactor Core Diagnostics
exercises.description: CHRONOS POWER SYSTEMS: Main reactor core requires real-time energy monitoring. Prompt the operator to input current core energy reading (0-100 scale). Convert the input directly to integer format for immediate processing by the power management system. Critical for preventing overload conditions.
exercises.targetCode: energy_level = int(input("Enter current core energy reading (0-100): "))

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Biometric Access Verification
exercises.description: CHRONOS ACCESS CONTROL: Secure vault requires biometric security code verification. Check if the provided security_code matches the authorized value 1234 in the database. Use the equality comparison operator (==) to verify credentials and grant or deny access to classified materials.

exercises.title: System Repair: Type Mismatch Error
exercises.description: CRITICAL ERROR: System crashes when adding to input because input() returns a string, not a number. Convert the input to integer before arithmetic!

exercises.title: System Repair: Assignment vs Comparison
exercises.description: CHRONOS LOGIC FAILURE: The security gate is malfunctioning! We use == for comparison, not =. Fix the operator before unauthorized access!

exercises.title: Field Mission: Operative Age Clearance
exercises.description: CHRONOS SECURITY CHECKPOINT: Vetting new recruit for field operations. Minimum age requirement is 18 years for tactical deployment. Input candidate age and verify clearance status. Print True if qualified for duty, False if reassignment to support roles required.
exercises.starterCode: # Take input and check age clearance
tasks: Use >= operator to check if 18 or older

exercises.title: Field Mission: Signal Amplification
exercises.description: CHRONOS COMMUNICATIONS: Satellite signal too weak for secure transmission! Input the current signal strength value, amplify it by a factor of 10 using the signal booster array, then output the boosted signal power to establish connection.

exercises.title: Field Mission: Secure Vault Access
exercises.description: CHRONOS CLASSIFIED VAULT: Mainframe vault contains top-secret intelligence files. Input the access password and verify against the secure database. Print True if password matches 'mainframe' (case-sensitive security protocol), False to trigger lockdown.

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Secure Terminal Login
exercises.description: CHRONOS SECURITY CHECKPOINT: Operative attempting to access classified terminal. Activate identity verification protocol by prompting for username credentials. Display the entered username for visual confirmation before granting system access. This prevents unauthorized entry to sensitive systems.

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Operative Enrollment System
exercises.description: CHRONOS ACADEMY HEADQUARTERS: New recruit enrollment protocol initiated. Collect complete identity profile: first name, last name, and secure email contact. Process all three data points and confirm successful registration with full identity display. This creates the operative's permanent record in the Chronos database.
exercises.targetCode:
# User registration form
first_name = input("First Name: ")
last_name = input("Last Name: ")
email = input("Email: ")
print("Registration complete for", first_name, last_name)

exercises.title: Debug Challenge: Keypad Type Mismatch
exercises.description: URGENT ALERT: Mainframe keypad malfunction! Comparing string to integer. Fix type conversion before lockout (30 seconds)!

exercises.title: Surveillance: Shift Pattern Detection
exercises.description: CHRONOS INTEL: Tracking enemy guard rotations. Input shift hour. Print True if even hour (vulnerable), False if odd (heavy security). Use modulo operator.
exercises.starterCode: # Detect shift pattern - even hours are vulnerable\n

exercises.title: Cover Identity: Alias Generator
exercises.description: CHRONOS BLACK OPS: Generate cover identity for undercover work. Input first and last name, print reversed (last, first) for fake passport.
exercises.starterCode: # Generate cover identity by reversing name order\n

exercises.title: Arctic Mission: Temperature Decoder
exercises.description: CHRONOS SATELLITE INTEL: Spy satellite detected activity in Siberia. Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit using formula: (C × 9/5) + 32. Accurate intel critical!

exercises.title: Boss Challenge: Agent Clearance System
exercises.description: CHRONOS FINAL SECURITY: Vetting field agent for high-risk vehicle operation. Input age, license status, insurance status. Print True ONLY if: Age ≥18 AND has license AND has insurance. Triple verification required!
exercises.starterCode:
# Triple-verification security protocol
age = int(input())
has_license = input()
has_insurance = input()
exercises.solution:
age = int(input())
has_license = input()
has_insurance = input()
print(age >= 18 and has_license == 'True' and has_insurance == 'True')
tasks: Check all three conditions with AND
